items.stem:
The cost, $C, of hiring a bicycle for h hours is given by the formula

C = 6h + 15

parts.t: Work out the cost of hiring a bicycle for 7 hours.
Nadia pays $111 to hire a bicycle. Work out the number of hours she hires it for.
Find the value of A when b = −2.5 and c = 6.
Find the value of b when A = 30 and c = 2.

sols: keep the negative number in brackets

items.stem:
A temperature of C degrees Celsius is equal to F degrees Fahrenheit, where

F = 9C⁄5 + 32

parts.t: Calculate F when C = 35.
Calculate C when F = 5.

ms:
M1 for 9C⁄5 = 5 − 32 or −27 seen
A1
SC1 for answer 15

items.stem:
The time, T seconds, for one swing of a pendulum of length L metres is given by

T = 2π√ L⁄g

parts.t: Calculate T when L = 1.8 and g = 9.8. Give your answer correct to 3 significant figures.
Make L the subject of the formula.

ms:
M1 for T⁄2π = √(L/g) or squaring both sides correctly
A1
oe e.g. L = g(T⁄2π)²
sols: work out the bracket first, then the square root

parts.t: Calculate v when u = 4, a = 2.5 and s = 12. Give your answer correct to 3 significant figures.
Calculate s when v = 20, u = 8 and a = 3.

items.stem:
A plumber charges a fixed fee of $35 for a visit, plus $28 for each hour that she works.
She works for h hours and the total charge is $C.

parts.t: Write down a formula for C in terms of h.

The total charge for one job is $189.
Work out the number of hours the plumber worked.

ms:
B2
B1 for 28h seen or for … + 35 seen
oe

M1 for 28h = 189 − 35 or 154 seen
A1
FT their (a) if linear
sols: Charge for h hours of work = 28 × h = 28h dollars
The fixed fee of $35 is added on whatever the number of hours.

items.stem:
The volume, V, of a sphere of radius r is given by

V = 4⁄3πr³

parts.t: Calculate the volume of a sphere of radius 6.5 cm. Give your answer correct to 3 significant figures.

A different sphere has volume 500 cm³.
Calculate its radius, correct to 3 significant figures.

items.stem:
A box contains x pencils.
A crate contains 24 of these boxes.
There are N pencils altogether in c crates.

parts.t: Write down a formula for N in terms of c and x.

N = 4320 and c = 5.
Find the value of x.

ms:
B2
B1 for 24c or 24x seen as part of a product
oe
sols: Number of pencils in one crate = 24 × x = 24x

items.stem:
For a lens, the distances u, v and f are connected by the formula

1⁄f = 1⁄u + 1⁄v

parts.t: Calculate f when u = 12 and v = 18.

Make u the subject of the formula.
Give your answer as a single fraction in its simplest form.

ms:
M1 for 1⁄12 + 1⁄18 or 5⁄36 seen
A1
M0 for answer 5⁄36 only

M1 for 1⁄u = 1⁄f − 1⁄v
M1 for combining into a single fraction (v − f)⁄fv
A1
oe, nfww
sols: the reciprocal — do not stop at <sup>5</sup>⁄<sub>36</sub>
write the right-hand side as a single fraction over fv
take the reciprocal of both sides

items.stem:
The diagram shows a solid cylinder of radius r cm and height h cm.
Its volume is V cm³ and its total surface area is A cm².

parts.t: Show that  A = 2πr² + 2V⁄r.
Calculate A when r = 5 and V = 900. Give your answer correct to 3 significant figures.
Calculate V when A = 250 and r = 4. Give your answer correct to 3 significant figures.

ms:
M1 for A = 2πr² + 2πrh and h = V⁄πr² both seen
A1 for correct substitution and cancelling, nfww

M1 for 2π × 5² or 157.0… seen, or 2 × 900⁄5 or 360 seen
A1
sols: Total surface area = 2 circular ends + curved surface
make h the subject of the volume formula

items.stem: y = 3x² − 2x

parts.t: Find the value of y when x = −2.
Find the value of y when x = 1⁄2.

sols: put the negative number in brackets

items.stem:
Tickets for a coach trip cost $12 for each adult and $7 for each child.
A group of a adults and c children pay a total of $T.

parts.t: Write down a formula for T in terms of a and c.
Work out the total cost for 4 adults and 6 children.

sols: Cost of the adult tickets = 12 × a = 12a dollars
Cost of the child tickets = 7 × c = 7c dollars

items.stem:
The area, A, of a trapezium with parallel sides a and b and height h is

A = 1⁄2(a + b)h

parts.t: Calculate A when a = 7, b = 11 and h = 6.
Calculate h when A = 84, a = 9 and b = 5.

items.stem:
The width of a rectangle is w cm.
The length of the rectangle is 3 cm more than twice its width.
The perimeter of the rectangle is P cm.

parts.t: Show that P = 6w + 6.
Find the value of w when P = 54.

ms:
M1 for length = 2w + 3 seen
A1 for 2(w + 2w + 3) oe correctly simplified, nfww
sols: check: the rectangle is 8 cm by 19 cm, perimeter 54 ✓

items.stem:
The simple interest, $I, earned when $P is invested for T years at R% per year is given by

I = PRT⁄100

parts.t: Calculate I when P = 800, R = 4.5 and T = 3.
Calculate R when I = 135, P = 1200 and T = 2.5.

items.stem:
A ball is thrown upwards. Its height, h metres, after t seconds is given by

h = 20t − 5t²

parts.t: Find the height of the ball after 2 seconds.
Find the two values of t when the ball is at a height of 15 metres.

ms:
M1 for 20t − 5t² = 15 rearranged to 5t² − 20t + 15 = 0 or t² − 4t + 3 = 0
M1 for (t − 1)(t − 3) oe or correct use of the formula
A1 for both values
sols: factorise: two numbers with product 3 and sum −4
the ball passes 15 m on the way up and again on the way down

items.stem:
The kinetic energy, E joules, of an object of mass m kg moving at v m/s is

E = 1⁄2mv²

parts.t: Calculate E when m = 50 and v = 12.
Make v the subject of the formula.
Find v when E = 8100 and m = 50.

sols: square root both sides; the speed is positive

items.stem:
An empty tank holds V litres when full.
Water flows into the tank at f litres per minute and, at the same time, leaks out through a hole at r litres per minute, where f > r.
The tank takes T minutes to fill.

parts.t: Write down a formula for T in terms of V, f and r.
Find T when V = 900, f = 20 and r = 8.

A tank with V = 900 and f = 20 takes 60 minutes to fill.
Find the value of r.

ms:
B2
B1 for f − r seen as the net rate
oe
sols: Net rate at which the water level rises = f − r litres per minute
the net rate must be 15 litres per minute

parts.t: Find the value of P when x = 4 and y = 2.5.
Make x the subject of the formula.

ms:
M1 for x(3 + y) seen (factorising the terms in x)
M1 for dividing by their bracket
A1
oe, nfww
sols: x appears in both terms on the right
factorise: take out the common factor x

Calculate R, correct to 3 significant figures.

items.stem:
The diagram shows a shape made from a rectangle, 3x cm by 2x cm, and a semicircle whose diameter is one of the shorter sides of the rectangle.
The perimeter of the shape is P cm.

parts.t: Show that P = (8 + π)x.

Find the value of x when P = 50.
Give your answer correct to 3 significant figures.

ms:
M1 for the semicircle arc = 1⁄2 × π × 2x = πx or for 3x + 2x + 3x = 8x seen
A1 for combining correctly, nfww
sols: the dashed side is inside the shape and is not part of the perimeter
The semicircle has diameter 2x, so radius x. Arc length = 1⁄2 × 2πx = πx
half the circumference of a circle of radius x

items.stem:
When $P is invested for n years at r% per year compound interest, the value of the investment, $A, is given by

A = P(1 + r⁄100)n

parts.t:
Calculate A when P = 2500, r = 3 and n = 4.
Give your answer correct to 2 decimal places.

Calculate P when A = 3000, r = 4 and n = 5.
Give your answer correct to 2 decimal places.

ms:
M1 for 3000 ÷ 1.045 oe or 1.045 = 1.2166… seen
A1
2500 (from 3000 ÷ 1.2) scores M0
sols: substitute the values; the bracket is 1.03
work out the power before multiplying

items.stem: y = √ (x + a)⁄(x − a)

parts.t: Find the value of y when x = 5 and a = 3.
Make x the subject of the formula.

ms:
M1 for y² = (x + a)⁄(x − a)
M1 for y²(x − a) = x + a and expanding
M1 for x(y² − 1) = a + ay² oe (collecting x terms and factorising)
A1
oe, e.g. ay² + a⁄(y² − 1), nfww
sols: work out the fraction before taking the square root
square both sides to remove the root
collect the terms containing x on the left

items.stem:
The diagram shows a cone with base radius r cm, perpendicular height h cm and slant height l cm.
The curved surface area, C cm², of the cone is given by C = πrl.

parts.t: Show that  C = πr√(r² + h²).

Calculate C when r = 5 and h = 12.
Give your answer correct to 3 significant figures.
Make h the subject of the formula  C = πr√(r² + h²).

ms:
M1 for l² = r² + h² (Pythagoras) seen
A1 for substituting l = √(r² + h²) into πrl, nfww
sols: The radius, height and slant height form a right-angled triangle with l as the hypotenuse.

items.stem:
The distance, s metres, travelled in t seconds by an object with initial speed u m/s and acceleration a m/s² is given by

s = ut + 1⁄2at²

parts.t: Calculate s when u = 15, a = 2.5 and t = 4.

Find the value of t when s = 90, u = 15 and a = 2.5.
Give your answer correct to 3 significant figures.
Make a the subject of the formula.

ms:
M1 for 1.25t² + 15t − 90 = 0 oe (e.g. 5t² + 60t − 360 = 0)
M1 for correct substitution into the quadratic formula
A1
ignore the negative root −16.39… if the positive one is chosen
sols: time cannot be negative, so reject the negative root
